patterns.name: local-app-sqlite-storage
patterns.evidence: backend/services/stagingService.js initializes data/staging_attendance.db, creates tables/indexes on startup, and exposes promise-based CRUD helpers.

patterns.name: payroll-live-response-shape
patterns.evidence: backend/services/payrollService.js returns { success, data, analysis } where data rows include employee identity, Venus totals/details, millware object, and sync component pairs.

patterns.name: downstream-payroll-reuse
patterns.evidence: payrollAutomationService.js, payrollADResetService.js, and payrollExportService.js all depend on fetchPayrollData(month, year).

patterns.name: frontend-direct-fetch
patterns.evidence: PayrollReport.jsx fetches /api/payroll directly and stores data/analysis locally.

dependencies: mssql through employeeMillService for employee_mill mapping
gateway executeQuery for Venus and Millware live queries

integration_points.notes: New service should own schema init, snapshot CRUD, capture, activation, and conversion back to payroll response shape.
Refactor live fetch into provider that can return live data or snapshot data by options.
Add snapshot endpoints and extend existing payroll endpoints with source/useSnapshot/snapshotId parameters.
Pass source options into fetchPayrollData so automation/export/reset can use frozen data.
Add snapshot capture/list/select/use-live controls and propagate chosen source to payroll actions.

constraints: Planning-only workflow; do not implement in this session.
Preserve existing /api/payroll response shape for compatibility.
Snapshot reads must not query Venus or Millware.
Snapshot rows should be immutable after capture except status/label/notes metadata.
Implementation must inspect dirty diffs before editing touched files.
Use focused tests for public snapshot service functions and payroll source selection.

recommended_schema.storage: SQLite data/payroll_snapshot.db by default; portable to SQL Server if central storage is required.
